note: B.AI (b.ai) model catalog — aggregator for GPT/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/Hunyuan/MiMo/Grok/GLM/Kimi/Qwen/MiniMax families. Edit this file and the Fetch Models button in 10Router will pull the latest list. Model IDs are credential-bound: the authoritative list for your key is GET https://api.b.ai/v1/models (Bearer auth). Optional per-model capability fields: vision (bool), reasoning (bool), contextWindow (int), maxOutput (int), thinkingFormat (string).
